repos_data.description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.

~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.
Efficient Triton Kernels for LLM Training

A simple, lightweight shell script to interact with OpenAI or Ollama or Mistral AI or LocalAI or ZhipuAI from the terminal, and enhancing intelligent system management without any dependencies(pure shell).
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to multiple Large Language Model (LLM) APIs including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Kimi K2, and DeepSeek.
Mistral MCP server for document extraction: invoices, contracts and typed JSON from text, Markdown or OCR. Six-tool core, chat, vision, audio, stdio and Streamable HTTP.
Build and publish websites through AI conversation. 27+ MCP tools, OAuth 2.1 auto-discovery. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral/Le Chat, Cursor and more.
